behavior: DeviceGray, DeviceRGB, and DeviceCMYK accept one-element array forms in strict and recovery rendering. Color spaces requiring parameters still reject incomplete arrays.
limitations: The page gradient is recovered, but a one-pixel height difference remains tracked. The reported pixel error covers only the common top-left extent without resizing. Single-file timing is not a throughput benchmark. Full PDF.js coverage has not been rerun at this build.
